classes.reason: Finite scan precedes outputs; finite max preserves first equal value. detmath exp -> original adjacent sum -> division -> rank of probabilities, with lower-index tie break -> original selected-probability sum -> division. No raw-logit ranking shortcut.

IDs validated before conversion; descriptor fields and repeated-row modulo match. Error is delayed until outputs are initialized. Folded producer emits the same route descriptors; dropped repeated-row storage is not observable by its rewired consumers.

classes.reference: core_v2.hpp hc_combine followed by norm; kernels.hpp combine_norm
classes.reason: Round combined value to BF16 before squaring, retain the original combined BF16 output, preserve sigmoid/divide/multiply/add parentheses and gain multiplication. New norm is the complete-subtree reduction followed by original upper nodes.
Square each original value, sum exact ordered tree, divide by width, add 1e-6, detmath rsqrt, multiply input*inv then gain+unit, finally BF16 put. Registered production shape four streams x2560.

Each lane sums four products from +0 then tree32. q/k normalization, decay, prediction, delta and updated state retain operation order. State and output round only at original BF16 writes; sequential token loop reads the previous rounded state.
Width128 square tree and inverse norm unchanged. Multiply by gain before sigmoid gate; no intervening BF16 rounding, then final BF16 output.
Per-head tree128/256, normalize and round to BF16 before rotary. Rotary uses unchanged BF16 tables and preserves a*c-b*s / b*c+a*s parentheses; final output rounds exactly once.

Four chronological inputs sum from +0, divide by4, BF16 round before norm/rotary. Existing earlier complete pools remain unchanged; only newly complete pools recompute. Append reads previous cache positions or current input exactly as reference.
Per-block private tree128, max(0,dot) per head, four-head sum from +0, divide by sqrt128. Rank all finite scores with earlier-block tie break; sentinel fill and trailing tokens preserved.
Tree256 product order and division by sqrt256 preserved; absent selection writes negative infinity; invalid IDs flagged before address arithmetic.
Max over original chronological scores, detmath exp subtraction, complete-subtree sums with odd-tail +0 then division. Invalid/tail selection checks precede use.

For valid selections, original probability*BF16 value leaves, same ordered sum, BF16 round before sigmoid-gate multiply, final BF16 output. Poisoned standalone diagnostic output is explicitly outside byte-parity claim; see finding B2.
Finite data selects lower index on ties by ascending chunk and within-chunk strict comparison. Nonfinite fallback repeats original 128-lane selection order and sets the same error output.

Preserves inner BF16(b+c) before adding a, followed by output BF16 conversion; no reassociation.

classes.reason: Type and candidate are template constants; same per-lane eight-product order, adjacent subgroup tree32, and split4 upper tree (p0+p1)+(p2+p3).
